problems.original_quote: remains, to the best of our knowledge, somewhat underexplored in the existing literature
problems.revised_quote: to the best of our knowledge, whether reviewer identity affects this relationship remains underexplored
problems.explanation: Dropping the hedge "somewhat" makes the gap claim stronger than the author stated.

problems.original_quote: reviewer identity has a significant effect
problems.revised_quote: Reviewer identity has a significant effect on this relationship.
problems.explanation: The original does not say what reviewer identity affects; the revision adds that it moderates the review–sales relationship, which is a different finding from a direct effect on sales.

problems.original_quote: has fundamentally transformed the way in which consumers make purchasing decisions
problems.revised_quote: has transformed how consumers make purchasing decisions

problems.original_quote: we leverage a novel dataset comprising of 1.2 million reviews
problems.revised_quote: we use a dataset of 1.2 million reviews

parsed.summary: Most edits are filler removal and tightening. However, the revision drops the "somewhat" hedge on the literature gap. It also states that reviewer identity affects the review–sales relationship, while the original left the target of the effect unspecified.
